question: How much did I get paid in two weeks?
expected_answer: PAYSLIP. Period: fortnight ending 30 September. Gross earnings AUD 2500. Tax withheld AUD 500. Net payment AUD 2000.

text: Annual leave requests need manager approval at least fourteen days before the planned absence.
question: Who approves my holiday request?
expected_answer: Annual leave requests need manager approval at least fourteen days before the planned absence.

text: After a medication incident notify the clinical supervisor and record the event in the incident register.
question: What should I do if the wrong medicine was administered?
expected_answer: After a medication incident notify the clinical supervisor and record the event in the incident register.

text: Faulty equipment must be isolated, labelled out of service and reported to facilities.
question: The machine has broken. Can I keep using it?
expected_answer: Faulty equipment must be isolated, labelled out of service and reported to facilities.

text: New employees require their manager to request workstation access through the IT service desk.
question: How do new staff get a computer login?
expected_answer: New employees require their manager to request workstation access through the IT service desk.

text: Supplier ACME-482 supplies nitrile examination gloves. Order through procurement.
question: Who supplies our examination gloves?
expected_answer: Supplier ACME-482 supplies nitrile examination gloves. Order through procurement.

text: Database backups run nightly. Restore to an isolated environment and verify data before promotion.
question: How often is our database backed up?
expected_answer: Database backups run nightly. Restore to an isolated environment and verify data before promotion.

text: Customers may request a refund within thirty days with the original receipt.
question: Can a customer get their money back after a fortnight?
expected_answer: Customers may request a refund within thirty days with the original receipt.

text: On hearing the fire alarm evacuate through the nearest safe exit and assemble in the north car park.
question: Where do we meet when the alarm sounds?
expected_answer: On hearing the fire alarm evacuate through the nearest safe exit and assemble in the north car park.

text: Remote work is permitted two days each week with team leader approval.
question: How many days can I work from home?
expected_answer: Remote work is permitted two days each week with team leader approval.

text: Business travel requires approval before booking. Economy airfare and reasonable accommodation are reimbursable.
question: Do I need permission before buying flights for work?
expected_answer: Business travel requires approval before booking. Economy airfare and reasonable accommodation are reimbursable.

text: Account passwords require at least fourteen characters. Enable multi-factor authentication.
question: What are the rules for a new account password?
expected_answer: Account passwords require at least fourteen characters. Enable multi-factor authentication.

text: Suspected data exposure must be reported immediately to the security officer. Preserve relevant logs.
question: Who should I tell if confidential information leaks?
expected_answer: Suspected data exposure must be reported immediately to the security officer. Preserve relevant logs.

text: Mandatory safety training must be completed within the first week of employment.
question: When must a new starter finish safety induction?
expected_answer: Mandatory safety training must be completed within the first week of employment.

text: Invoice INV-2026-17 is due on 15 October. Amount payable AUD 740.00.
question: When do we need to pay invoice INV-2026-17?
expected_answer: Invoice INV-2026-17 is due on 15 October. Amount payable AUD 740.00.

text: Overtime must be authorised in advance. Approved hours are paid at one and a half times the ordinary hourly rate.
question: Is extra work paid at a higher rate?
expected_answer: Overtime must be authorised in advance. Approved hours are paid at one and a half times the ordinary hourly rate.

text: Notify your manager before your shift if unwell. A medical certificate is required after two consecutive days.
question: Do I need a doctors note after three sick days?
expected_answer: Notify your manager before your shift if unwell. A medical certificate is required after two consecutive days.

text: Incoming parcels are received at the rear loading dock between 8am and 4pm.
question: Where should a courier bring a package?
expected_answer: Incoming parcels are received at the rear loading dock between 8am and 4pm.

text: Customer records are retained for seven years after account closure unless a legal hold applies.
question: How long do we keep information after a customer leaves?
expected_answer: Customer records are retained for seven years after account closure unless a legal hold applies.

text: The next fortnight roster is published each Thursday afternoon in the staff portal.
question: When can I see my upcoming shifts?
expected_answer: The next fortnight roster is published each Thursday afternoon in the staff portal.

text: To connect from outside the office use the approved VPN client and complete the second-factor challenge.
question: How do I connect to the office network from home?
expected_answer: To connect from outside the office use the approved VPN client and complete the second-factor challenge.

text: Staff parking permits are issued by reception. Visitor spaces must remain available for guests.
question: Where can I get permission to park at work?
expected_answer: Staff parking permits are issued by reception. Visitor spaces must remain available for guests.

text: Submit expense receipts through the finance portal by the fifth working day of the following month.
question: When do I need to claim my work expenses?
expected_answer: Submit expense receipts through the finance portal by the fifth working day of the following month.

text: The monthly operations review occurs on the first Monday at 10am in meeting room Delta.

expected_answer: The monthly operations review occurs on the first Monday at 10am in meeting room Delta.

text: For a life-threatening emergency call the emergency services number immediately, then notify the duty manager.
